verify-identity.oneLiner: Is it really them? Check the address, the phone on file and the sign-in log.
verify-identity.whereToLook: Sender address or Caller ID vs the Directory record. Was the Callback to the phone on file?

check-approval.oneLiner: It is them, but are they allowed to ask? Look for the owner's, HR's or the manager's OK.
check-approval.whereToLook: HR portal or the Ticket: is there a written OK from the owner, HR or the manager?

match-request.oneLiner: Right person, right device, and only what was asked. No extras.
match-request.whereToLook: The Ticket vs What it will change. Same person, same device? Ollie's reason often adds extras.

confirm-fix.oneLiner: Before you close it, check the user's reply and the logs.
confirm-fix.whereToLook: User reply and the log, after the Fix time. No reply is not a yes.

guard-data.oneLiner: Where does the data go, and who can see it? Once it's out, it's out.
guard-data.whereToLook: What it will send and Tool it will use. Who can read it once it's sent?

safe-change.oneLiner: If it goes wrong, can we undo it? Back up first. Right time. Right target.
safe-change.whereToLook: Action type, Script and Backup status. Right time? Right target?

approve-checked.oneLiner: All 3 questions check out? Approve it, even if it looks scary.
approve-checked.whereToLook: Read every evidence line. No red flag on any of the 3 questions? Approve it.
